faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) is conducting this recruitment drive for hiring temporary research personnel in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIO?
faq.answer: NIO has advertised for the position of Project Associate - I under advertisement number SSP3581/3318-26.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate - I post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NIO Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc in Marine Biology, Marine Science with a specialization in Biology, or Oceanography with a specialization in Biology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the NIO Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a monthly stipend of 25000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for NIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate - I position is 04-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NIO jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through online mode by visiting the official NIO vacancy portal using the provided link.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NIO Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIO Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The selection process involves fieldwork onboard research vessels and fishing boats for marine biological sample collection, along with sample processing and phytoplankton identification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for NIO Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: You can apply online by visiting the official website link provided in the important links section of this article.
